Conavi Medical is a commercial stage medical device company focused on designing, manufacturing and marketing imaging technologies to guide minimally invasive cardiovascular procedures. Its OCTIV™ hybrid imaging system combines intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) and optical coherence tomography (OCT) to provide simultaneous, co-registered images of coronary arteries using a single imaging catheter. These complementary imaging modalities provide physicians with information to support treatment decisions during coronary interventions. For more information, visit conavi.com.
